items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the main highlight will be the UK Budget announcement at 12:30 GMT/08:30 ET. The UK Chancellor is expected to announce targeted tax increases and cost-of-living support, with markets focused on the OBR’s updated forecasts and the government’s fiscal headroom, estimated at around £15–16bn.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，主要亮点将是格林威治标准时间12:30/美国东部时间08:30的英国预算公告。预计英国财政大臣将宣布有针对性的增税和生活成本支持，市场重点关注OBR的最新预测和政府的财政余地，估计约为150-160亿£。
